messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: geom points works, but line does not
parts:
On Thu, Mar 12, 2009 at 8:42 AM, David Hajage <dha...@gmail.com> wrote:
> 'group' argument is missing :
>
> ggplot(aes(x=year,y=value, group = L1, colour = L1), data=mfoo) +
> geom_line() # working

The reason why you need this is because groups (which define which
points to join into a line) are formed by the combination of all
discrete variables in a plot, and in this plot year is a factor. This
means each point is in it's own group so you get a whole lot of lines
with only one point which are not drawn.

Hadley
